scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Manual VIN creation using Excel creates bottlenecks and error risk (intensity 8/10, stage: VIN Assigned) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Multiple SAP R/3 instances require complex integration and data synchronization (intensity 7/10, stage: Order Validated) ← flagged as binding
3. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] Phantom parts handling not supported by SAP coding affects dynamic production planning (intensity 6/10, stage: Production Scheduled)
4. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Retrofit parts taken directly from shelf without system tracking creates inventory blind spots (intensity 5/10, stage: Vehicle Produced)
5. [DataSignalFriction] Customer data synchronization between Post, BM and SAP Prevost creates data quality issues (intensity 6/10, stage: Customer Registered) ← flagged as binding

pc_order_validation_compliance.name: Order Validation Compliance Policy
pc_order_validation_compliance.description: All vehicle delivery orders must undergo validation before production commitment to ensure regulatory compliance and data accuracy

outcomes.description: Must validate order data completeness and regulatory compliance before production commitment
Cannot commit order to production without completed validation

pc_vin_assignment_governance.name: VIN Assignment Governance Policy
pc_vin_assignment_governance.description: Vehicle Identification Numbers must be assigned according to regulatory requirements and maintained with full traceability

outcomes.description: Must assign unique VIN from authorized pool with full audit trail
Must maintain VIN-to-order traceability throughout lifecycle
Cannot reuse or duplicate VIN assignments

pc_change_request_approval.name: Change Request Approval Policy
pc_change_request_approval.description: All changes to committed orders must undergo impact assessment and formal approval before implementation

outcomes.description: Must assess production and cost impact before approval decision
Must obtain formal approval from change manager before VDO update
May reject changes that exceed feasibility thresholds

pc_customer_data_protection.name: Customer Data Protection Policy
pc_customer_data_protection.description: Customer personal and financial information must be protected according to privacy regulations and access controls

outcomes.description: Must encrypt and secure all customer personal and financial data
Must implement role-based access controls for customer information
Cannot share customer data without explicit consent and business justification

pc_solution_governance.name: Solution Development Governance Policy
pc_solution_governance.description: All solution requirements and designs must follow approved governance processes and stakeholder approval gates

outcomes.description: Must obtain stakeholder approval before proceeding to solution design
Must document requirements traceability through design and implementation
Must validate solution design against approved requirements
